title: Hazel and the Inheritance
author: Oscar Nystrom
blurb: Wren Dravenmoor, a true-crime podcaster chasing the coldest case on record, has spent twenty years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
